test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.**

It is wierd to overreact on the consequences like this, it didn't even matter at the end of the day.
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is: **Wierd**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is "**weird**" with the letter "**i**" after "**e**".
 
• **Weird **means something that is strange, unusual, or out of the ordinary. (कुछ ऐसा जो अजीब, असामान्य या सामान्य से हटकर हो)
 
 
• **For example**: *Her choice of clothing was quite weird, featuring mismatched patterns and colours.*
 
 
 
• This sentence discusses the incorrectness of overreacting to consequences that don't matter in the end.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• '**Matter**' is spelt correctly and is used correctly in the sentence. (मामला)
 
• '**Overreact**' is spelt correctly and is used correctly in the sentence. (अत्यधिक प्रतिक्रिया)
 
• '**Consequences**' is spelt correctly and is used correctly in the sentence. (नतीजे)
